answer: Forge once and the fine is 6 times the stake, so a 138 POA proof becomes a 6x wound. The nadir opens the gate, the anchor pays the toll, the cipher proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Printers and agents look alike until Austringer gyrfalcon warrant flown at the moulting house calls for each gyrfalcon is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record; after that, only agents reply. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. A hundred keys, zero proofs: the farm's story, told the same way each epoch.
